articles.title: Sabalenka wins in China and works on being kinder to herself
articles.summary: Aryna Sabalenka won her opening China Open match in 63 minutes. She said high expectations can help her but also use up her energy.

articles.title: Canadian teenager and her favourite cow win a top dairy prize
articles.summary: Canadian teenager Alyson Doiron celebrated when her favourite cow, Ella, won a top prize on Sunday at the World Dairy Expo in Wisconsin.

articles.title: RuneScape's fantasy world may become an animated series
articles.summary: Lyrical Animation is developing a RuneScape series with Jagex and creator Charlie White. The project is in its early stages, with more details expected in 2027.
